Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a sales and use tax exemption for breathalyzers sold to businesses who provide alcohol for consumption on-site.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a sales and use tax exemption forbreathalyzers sold to businesses who provide alcohol for consumptiononsite; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of alcoholdetection breathalyzers or other devices, which are used to measure anindividual's blood alcohol content in an establishment that providesalcohol for consumption onsite, or for labor or services rendered inrespect to the installation of such devices.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to the useof alcohol detection breathalyzers or other devices, in anestablishment that provides alcohol for consumption onsite, for p. 1 SB 5003purposes of measuring an individual's blood alcohol content.
